Since bead of force is like Resilient Sphere, Having read the arguments both for and against fall damage, I would say no fall damage.

My reasoning is as follows: The kinetic energy transfer from a fall would be an external force which can not affect the person(s) inside.  Likewise since the sphere weighs 1 lb, It shows that the internal environment doesn't equate to the external.  It could be argued that the person(s) inside are either always standing at the bottom of the sphere due to it having its own version of gravity, or that world's gravity (an external force) has no affect, and therefore they couldn't even push on the side of the sphere.  So I would say the argument for no fall damage is greater than the argument for fall damage.
